text: My main symptom is Progressive difficulty walking. I also have Urinary incontinence, Slurred speech, Rigidity in limbs, Mild hand tremor, Orthostatic hypotension.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of your symptoms, particularly the gait disturbance, urinary incontinence, and rigidity, raises suspicion for Parkinson's disease or a related parkinsonian syndrome. Do you experience any visual hallucinations, rapid eye movement sleep behavior disorder, or significant cognitive decline?

text: Past medical history: Unremarkable. No known chronic diseases. Social history: Occasionally consumes alcohol. Non-smoker. Works as a bank clerk.

speaker: Doctor
text:
